name: Financial Instrument Reporting Currency Code Report V 01
definition: The MiFIRCurrencyCodeReport message provides the details the ISO 4217 currency codes and is created by ESMA for distribution to National Competent Authorities.

CurrencyData.name: Currency Data

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
